note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change. RFC text (rfc7947): "The route server SHOULD perform one or more BGP Decision Processes to select routes for subsequent advertisement to its clients, taking into account possible configuration to provide multiple Network Layer Reachability Information (NLRI) paths to a particular client as described in Section 2.3.2.2 or multiple Loc-RIBs as described in Section 2.3.2.1." be95c10053 wraps the settings of TestRSAnnouncementAddPathClientGetsEveryPath (and the shared fixture builders) in acceptingPolicies (FinalAccept import and export, no refs) because every peer is EBGP. An accepting policy removes no path, so every path the ADD-PATH client must receive is still selected by the route server's own election. Assertions unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history. Independent companion-fixture rejudgment against RFC 7947 Section 2.1, all four tagged entries and their assertion-producing helpers: the complete current non-ADD-PATH controls still require an inferior later arrival to send nothing and a worsened owner reannouncement to select the other source's exact route after causal settled TCP fences. The ADD-PATH carrier still requires two distinct identifiers and both exact paths; the client-policy carrier still refuses a denied survivor and selects the next permitted one or withdraws when none remains. The shared extendedRecoveryPeers helper now supplies terminal interior host routes for the scenario's next hops, proves their resolution through the real Loc-RIB, and registers cleanup. These prerequisite routes do not insert or remove any BGP prefix under judgment. lowLiveReconnect retains its complete establishment-and-initial-sync wait after the extracted same handshake. Only the deliberately held, untagged peer-up replay carrier moves that settlement observation after its release; its EOR, route order, elected attributes and no-withdrawal assertions stay intact. The exact existing advisory-level requirement, four-entry population and enforced verdict remain; this source judgment claims no new execution.
